name: Prayer Times
author: Ahmad Elyan
description: Islamic prayer times in the Omarchy bar, with a reminder before each azan, optional azan sound, and automatic or manual location.

barWidget.description: Next prayer time, pre-azan reminder and azan alert, computed offline for your location.

schema.label: Calculation method
schema.description: MWL: Muslim World League · Makkah: Umm al-Qura · Egypt: Egyptian Authority · ISNA: North America · Karachi · Tehran · Jafari · Gulf · Kuwait · Qatar · Singapore · Turkey (Diyanet)

schema.label: Asr calculation
schema.description: Standard: Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali. Hanafi: later Asr.

schema.label: Azan sound file
schema.description: An mp3/ogg/wav file played at prayer time. Leave empty for notification only.

schema.label: Fajr azan sound file
schema.description: Optional separate azan for Fajr. Falls back to the azan sound file.

schema.label: Adjust all times (minutes)
schema.description: Shift every prayer time to match your local mosque.

schema.label: Hijri date adjustment (days)
schema.description: Correct the Hijri date for local moon sighting.
